notes.title: 🎮 Claw & Load Demo – New Update Is Ready!
notes.content:
Hey Miners and Meowling Commanders!

The Claw & Load demo is getting an update! We've fixed bugs, added fresh content, and made improvements across the board — from smoother controls and better maps to a new boss, UI tweaks, and even a long-awaited tutorial and challenge mode.

✅ What's New in This Update[olist]      Character Control Improvements          Increased base movement speed and acceleration      Added new movement-speed-related upgrade options      Buffed existing movement-related upgrades            Magnet Item Rework          Removed the need for external upgrades to collect minerals      Now collects both minerals and XP by default            Machine Gun Upgrade Path          Added global damage boost against enemies for all weapons            Cat Archer Buffs          Increased damage on E and Q skills            Map & Resource Adjustments          Tweaked the number and placement of explosive blocks in early and snowy areas      Improved terrain between snowy area and treehole maze      Increased spawn points and frequency of blue mineral vendors and iron balls      Increased mineral drop rate in the cellar area      Adjusted meowshroom spawn zones and quantity            Game Pace Tweaks          Delayed the "Dark Night" event in the snowy area from 25 to 30 minutes            New Gameplay Content          Added post-clear Challenge Mode      Introduced a new boss in the Demonic Portal Zone            Poison Pool Changes          Changed to low HP drain + heavy slow      Visual guidance and warnings to be improved in future            New Player Tutorial          Added a short onboarding tutorial for new players            UI & Text Fixes          Fixed sound effect overlay issues during firing      Fixed upgrade UI error when dying during level-up      Fixed Traditional Chinese text clipping            Death Altar Guidance          Added directional hints after boss death            Orange Relic Adjustments          Added multiple new orange relic effects      Fixed bug where single-limit relics could appear multiple times            Visual Effects          Reduced brightness of certain skill effects      [/olist]
The updated demo will be live very soon — we’d love for you to give it a try!
Feel free to share your thoughts or report bugs in our Discord server.  We’re actively improving the game and working toward a stronger, fuller release!

notes.title: CLAW & LOAD: We've Heard You! Optimizations Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since the Demo went live, we've received a ton of enthusiastic feedback and suggestions from all of you players. We're truly grateful for your support and attention!
Whether it's about gameplay mechanics, control feel, map structure, or bug reports – we've carefully recorded everything, discussed it internally, and have already started making adjustments.

Currently, the areas we are focusing on optimizing include:

 Character movement and control feel
 The pick-up experience for the Magnet item
 Strength balancing for some weapons and skills
 Terrain structure and resource distribution
 Visual optimization of UI and special effects
 And more...

The team is going all out, striving to bring you a more polished and thrilling gaming experience.
A more detailed update plan and the complete list of adjustments are currently being compiled and will be shared with you soon via an official announcement.

Our heartfelt thanks to all players who tried the demo!
Your feedback plays an irreplaceable role in helping us optimize the game.

Special thanks to: Charlotte Blitz, PEET, F.E.A.R., Jarison, LanSomeone.WuLan, marcus1503YT, TwinDadderGuy, Massimo Solo, MaCobra, Avitokhoi, Super Szia, Atomic, Joga Lixo Games, GogetaSuperx, Next Level Gamer Guy, 徐不鸽, 冯桂山, 一天睡4小时猝死前的幻想, and many others – your suggestions have been immensely helpful to us!

Please continue to share your suggestions with us through our community and Discord channels.
We're eagerly looking forward to hearing your thoughts. Let's make the game better together!

Thank you for all your support along the way. See you in the game! ❤️

notes.title: Try the Demo Now!
notes.content:
🚀 Our Demo is Now Live on Steam! 🚀

Hi everyone!
We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for our game is officially available!
You can now experience the exciting combination of mining, shooting, and surviving — alongside our mischievous cat companion! 🐾

👉 Play the Demo Here!

What’s New Compared to the Playtest:

Level Design

 Early-game pacing has been significantly adjusted.
 The first half of Canyon of the Dead has been completely reworked, with clearer stage transitions focused on the mining phase.
 A new snowy biome and block type have been added.
 A mysterious cellar region is now explorable.
 One new level variant has also been introduced.

Gameplay

 Added new block types: rolling blocks and barrel blocks.
 More Cat Spirit weapons, special affixes, and achievements.
 Introduced a new difficulty system and unlockable features.
 Improved upgrade paths for various mining guns.
 Optimized how super weapons are obtained.
 Refined enemy formations, especially those that surround the player.

UI Improvements

 New selection interfaces for character, weapon, map, and difficulty.
 Various game and alert UI elements have been optimized.


Bug Fixes

 A large number of bugs have been fixed to improve overall stability and gameplay.


A Big Thank You!
We want to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in our previous Playtest.
Your feedback has been incredibly valuable in helping us polish the game.
Special thanks to: AraAra, RAW with Kohut, 旭, 云灬容 — your suggestions truly made a difference!

We also warmly welcome everyone to continue sharing your feedback and suggestions in our Discord. We’re excited to hear your thoughts and keep making the game better together!

Thank you all for your support, and we can't wait to hear what you think! ❤️
